statement: An environment-based version warning must distinguish package resolution from command execution. Reviewing Cejel PR #462, npm exec --offline --call with an explicit path to a 0.6.3 Cejel build inside a 0.6.4 package directory reproduced a false warning: the guard said npm resolved the checkout version and ran a PATH binary instead, although no package/version was requested and the command explicitly selected the artifact. npm_lifecycle_event=npx, package metadata, and a local bin directory first in PATH also occur in command mode. Rule: test alternative invocation modes that produce the same signals, and stay silent when the requested version is unknown.
